wizard.title: Script proposal
wizard.prompt_placeholder: Describe what the script should extract and from which file…
wizard.test_data_missing: Upload a test file in step 3: without one the script would run with nothing to read.
wizard.step5_no_aplica: Only applies to PDFs; a spreadsheet has no personal data to preview.

audit.revisable: With warnings: a reviewer can accept it

verdict.rechaza: does not do what was asked

declaracion.finalidad_ejemplo: Extract the expenses table from the monthly ERP file
declaracion.incompleta: Say what it is for and pick at least one data category: without those it cannot be shared.
declaracion.otra_categoria: Another category, if it is not listed
declaracion.porque: Saving this script shares it with your department: from then on someone else can use it in their reports. That is why you have to say what it is for and what data it handles — nobody reviews it beforehand, so the declaration is what makes reviewing it afterwards possible.
